**Linux / macOS**
```bash
ls *.py                  # 仅当前层
ls **/*.py               # 含子目录（bash 需先 shopt -s globstar）
find . -name "*.py" -not -path "*/.*"
```

**Windows PowerShell**
```powershell
Get-ChildItem -Filter *.py
Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.py
```

python -c "import pathlib;[print(p) for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.py')]"
